s2.ptxt: Set the turn signal switch to the neutral position.

atten3.ptxt: Always perform this in the neutral position, as the turn signal switch pin may break.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 3 claws to install the spiral cable w/ steering sensor.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the spiral cable with a new one, remove the lock pin of the spiral cable before installing the steering wheel assembly.

s2.ptxt: Connect each connector to the spiral cable and steering sensor.

atten3.ptxt: If the installation procedure is incorrect, gaps may form in the column cover.

Engage the 2 claws and install the steering column cover (lower side).
Engage the 4 claws.
Engage the claws.

atten3.ptxt: Push the bottom surface of the steering column cover (lower side) to securely engage the claws.

s2.ptxt: Check that the IG is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

atten3.ptxt: After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Slowly turn the spiral cable counterclockwise until it locks.

item.ptxt: To prevent breaking the spiral cable, turn it gently without applying force.
Do not turn the spiral cable 2.5 or more turns left or right from the matchmark, as it may break.

atten4.ptxt: The spiral cable rotates approximately 5 turns maximum.

Align the matchmarks and install the steering wheel assembly to the steering column assembly.

Connect the airbag connector to the horn button assembly and lock it securely.
Using a torx socket wrench (T30), install the horn button assembly to the steering wheel assembly with the 2 torx bolts.
